title: Istana Kaca Meucermin .
intro: Bayangkan saboh nanggroe nyang jiôh nyang kaya dan meugah dipat mata uroe jiseumah sibagoe gantoe Pencipta jih. Saboh surat teuka deungon saboh panggilan njang hana djeuët ta peu-abeh, dan saboh perdjalanan djimulai u arah saboh peungadilan njang leubèh rajek nibak njang ka djikalon seugohlom njan. Di sinan, ilusi akan teupeuhah lé saboh lantai njang peungeut mata, dan siat njang djeulaih akan meu-ubah bandum.
clues: Lon mat peurintah ateuh saboh nanggroe nyang makmu nyang rakyat jih sujud keu mata uroe sibagoe gantoe Allah.
Lon teurimong surat mulia njang djihôi ulôn untôk bèk peu-ék droë tapi untôk teuka deungon tundok keu Allah.
Lon meukonsultasi ngon dewan lon dan lon pileh diplomasi dilee, lon kirem hadiah untuk lon tes ureung nyang kirem.
Lon teuka u Sulayman, dan takhta lon keudroe geupeusampoe keu lon deungon cara meusamar keu geu uji pengakuan lon.
Lon tamong lam saboh meuligoe nyang manyang nyang lantai kaca jih nyang gleh lon salahkan keu ie nyang dalam.
Lon peunyata tundok droe lon ngon Sulaiman keu Allah, Tuhan alam.

identity.label: Soe Lon?
options: Adek Musa .
Istri Aceh Abu Lahab Aceh .
Peurumoh Nuh .
Bilqis, Peunguasa Saba .
Zulaikha, Istri Al-Aziz .

trial.label: Sidang/Acara
options: Diteu’ôt lé eungkôt raya di dalam laôt .
Dipeugot le peunyaket meuthon-thon dan gadoh keuluarga .
Diyue peukorban aneuk tercinta lam mimpi .
Geu uji le takhta nyang meusamar ngon meuligoe kaca .
Di rhom lam apui nyang teungoh meuapui-apui sabab jipeubreuk patong-patong .
trial.answer: Geu uji le takhta nyang meusamar ngon meuligoe kaca .

location.label: Unsur Kunci
options: Bahtera nyan geupeudong ateueh ie .
Guha teumpat meulindong ureueng teungeut .
Lantai istana kristal (Sarh)
Krueng Nil bak masa eksodus .
Apui nyang geupeusiap lé ureuëng seumah patông .

outcome.label: Hasee
options: Ka jiteugom lé bumoe ngon hareuta ulôn .
Teutab hana meuiman dan binasa meusajan ngon umat lon .
Tunyok ngon Sulaiman keu Allah, Tuhan alam .
Karam lam laot watee geujak peulet ureung mukmin .
Ka jeuet keu batée sabab jilanggar uroe Sabat .
outcome.answer: Tunyok ngon Sulaiman keu Allah, Tuhan alam .

arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ قِيلَ أَهَـٰكَذَا عَرْشُكِ ۖ قَالَتْ كَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ ۚ وَأُوتِينَا ٱلْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَ
verse: So when she arrived, it was said [to her], "Is your throne like this?" She said, "[It is] as though it was it." [Solomon said], "And we were given knowledge before her, and we have been Muslims [in submission to Allāh]. (27:42)
